title: PM Lecornu Warns of Financial Crisis Risk Ahead of Austerity 'Redressement' Budget
detail: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu warned of the risks of a financial crisis ahead of presenting his 'redressement' (recovery) budget, signaling a significant austerity push under political pressure. The budget is framed as a fiscal correction measure as France faces ongoing pressure over its deficit and public finances.

title: School Blockade Protests Escalate Nationally: 625 Arrests Wednesday, Movement Widening
detail: Interior Minister announced 625 arrests on Wednesday as nationwide school blockade protests escalated and widened beyond initial hot spots. The minister noted the movement is spreading to new regions across France.

title: Gabriel Serville, President of French Guiana Territorial Collectivity, Dies at 67
detail: Gabriel Serville, president of the territorial collectivity of French Guiana, died at the age of 67. Serville had served as the head of the overseas territory's governing body, representing one of France's largest overseas territories in South America.
